Reporter exhausted 5 DISTINCT WORKAROUND APPROACHES each documented with failure mode (most exhaustive workaround-documentation in catalog): (1) Raise thresholds to 200k blockAfter=10 -- "Avoids blocking but OM rarely runs, defeating its purpose. When it does run, it is very slow"; (2) Lower thresholds to match Mastra Code (30k) -- "Triggers too often due to tool results inflating token count"; (3) Make OM only process DB-persisted messages -- "This is the desired approach but requires changes to OM internals"; (4) Custom input processor to strip tool results before OM -- "Would work but diverges from native OM behavior"; (5) OM sanitization features (sanitizeToolResultValue, maxToolResultTokens=10k) -- "OM already has some built-in sanitization but it is insufficient -- it caps individual tool results at 10k but does not exclude them from token counting toward the threshold." Reporter explicit framework-architectural-mistake: "Tool results are used for the current generation step only -- they should not count toward OM thresholds. System prompt is computed dynamically each turn -- should not be observed. OM should run 100% in background, processing the conversation as it exists in storage." In a builder agent reading entire files and skills, each tool result is 10-30k tokens." Tool result size scaling: 10-30k tokens each x toolCallConcurrency: 10 = 30-150k tokens of tool results per single agent step.
